existing_mapping.evidence: The ParkingLot class contains attributes for a unique identifier, name, address, and city.
The ParkingLot class includes an attribute for available spaces, indicating the number of unoccupied parking spaces.
Each Vehicle is associated with a Client through a one-to-many relationship, ensuring that each vehicle links to one client.
The ParkingSession class captures session specifics like start time and is related to Vehicle, indicating it holds vehicle details.
ParkingSpace has a size attribute that classifies each space as small, medium, or large for vehicle accommodation.
Conveyor class defines a maximum weight capacity, specifying the vehicle weight it can handle.
The case model states a lack of need to store conveyors used by vehicles post session completion.
PriceList class holds pricing for first hour, additional hours, and full day, linked to relevant ParkingLot.
The ClubMember class within the case model represents the management of a client club.
ClubMember and PaymentGateway indicate automatic discounts for club members on parking sessions.
ClubMember is associated with a rule where the first parking session in the registration month is free.
The Administrator class has the capability to generate an annual summary report detailing incomes.
The Annual Summary Report includes amounts paid per lot and counts vehicles of "other" colors in its details.
The model specifies ordering of the report by city in descending order and amounts in ascending order.
The Report class specifies formats of PDF and XML for generated reports.
The Report generation function includes a method for generating a monthly overview of club growth.
The system tracks monthly new club members, total members, and calculates growth rates.
The Customer Club Growth Report is organized monthly in ascending order.
